Source docs:
- to-fix/09-restate-architecture-steal-plan.md

- Restate is failure-mode inspiration only; do not copy code, APIs, data model, module structure, async architecture, HTTP/JSON paths, storage layout, wire formats, or distributed assumptions.
- Master contract overrides this bead. Runtime/core work stays single-server, shard-owned, numeric, bounded, and free of JSON/YAML/HTTP interpretation. CLI/doctor diagnostics are cold-path only.

Test file:
- crates/workspace_tests/tests/restate_fjall_keyspace_manifest_tests.rs

Command evidence:
- cargo nextest run -p velvet-ballastics-workspace-tests --test restate_fjall_keyspace_manifest_tests
- moon ci

Scope:
Create tests and manifest assertions for exact VB Fjall keyspaces, stable prefixes, and big-endian numeric key ordering.

Target public surface / files to read:
- /tmp/opencode/restate/crates/partition-store/src/keys.rs
- crates/vb_storage/src/keys.rs
- velvet-ballistics-MASTER.md

Acceptance tests:
Happy paths:
- Run event keys sort by RunId then SeqNo
- Action index keys sort by action correlation and sequence

Error paths:
- invalid input unknown prefix returns typed decode error
- missing key bytes return typed short-key error

Edge cases:
- u64 maximum sequence sorts after lower sequences
- adjacent keyspaces do not overlap by prefix

Contract assertions:
- Manifest covers workflow_source compiled_ir run_header run_event run_snapshot blob index_status index_workflow index_action
- Every hot key has encode and checked decode tests

Preconditions:
- VB storage key files and Master section 18 have been read
- Restate key prefix tests have been read

Postconditions:
- Manifest tests enumerate all required keyspaces
- Ordering tests prove byte order matches numeric order

Invariants:
- No string keys on hot path
- Prefix bytes are stable
- Decode rejects unknown prefixes

Implementation gates:
- Write failing tests in the named workspace_tests file before production changes.
- Implement only the minimal VB change required by those tests.
- Close only with raw output from the scoped cargo nextest command and moon ci.
